topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: I must admit, I handled the news with a composure that surprised even me. My best friend, the one who's been there through every blip and highlight of our lives, is moving across the country. It's not like I didn't see the signs, the growing silence between us, the job she mentioned that whispered of new horizons. Yet, when she finally said it, I didn’t crumble. I stood firm, a steady pillar. I told her, with a calmness that felt almost rehearsed, that I understood, that she should chase her dreams, and that the distance wouldn’t sever our bond. Inside, I knew I was handling this better than most, and I couldn’t help but feel a subtle surge of satisfaction. Our friendship, after all, is stronger than a mere change in scenery.
